Aborts when redirect count exceeds max_redirects limit

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"max_redirects\":2,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.redirect_count)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.pages, 0).status_code)
```
